1879324025.Effect_SendMail_Message:
Hullo there, and well-met! I hope this missive is not intruding upon anything important, and if by unhappy chance it is, then I am sure you will disregard it and take no offence. But it is my very sincere hope that it does not intrude, and instead is met with some degree of interest and curiosity in the matter I propose. For, you see, I have need of some help with a small matter, and...

Well, I say a 'small' matter, but I do not know how long it might take. It could end up being quite a 'big' matter, as these things go! But we will not know until it is quite underway, will we?

If you are interested in learning more, I ask that you please seek me out at my comfortable hobbit-hole just north of the Town Hole, in Michel Delving, being the principal town of the Shire.

Yours in need and looking forward to your positive reply,

Mr. Bingo Boffin, Michel-delving

1879408377.Effect_SendMail_Message:
My dear friend,

I hope this letter finds you well, and continuing to fight for the Free People of Middle-earth in any capacity you can; the forces of evil are always arrayed against us, despite the victories or defeats of their dark master. And yet, I know in my heart that we must take what rest we can, and cherish times of peace that we may steel our resolve for times of hardship. To that end, I desire your attendance at my wedding to Arwen Undómiel. The wedding is planned for Midsummer's Day, and stable-masters in major towns and cities should be able to bring you hither as that day approaches. I await you in the Tower of Ecthelion in Minas Tirith (Midsummer), my friend! Let us make the most of this time of celebration, for our recent adventures have shown me that danger is never far off, and a time of peace must be appreciated, lest it vanish for good.

Your friend Aragorn Elessar, King of Gondor
